_comment: 20 relics in two tiers. rarity 'common' — from elites, events V04/V11, the shop (130g) and chests. rarity 'advanced' — ONLY from the chapter 1 and 2 boss 2-pick; each one is meant to define a build axis. `effect` is the key BattleCore / RunState switch on; `value` is its single number.

N01.desc_zh: 每回合你施放的第一個靈術,費用 -1(最低 1)
N01.desc_en: The first Ritual you cast each turn costs 1 less (minimum 1)

N05.desc_zh: 每場戰鬥開始時 +2 靈息
N05.desc_en: +2 Essence at the start of each battle

N11.desc_zh: 每場戰鬥第 1 回合重擲 +2
N11.desc_en: +2 rerolls on turn 1 of each battle

N12.desc_zh: 回合結束時剩餘靈息 3 點或以上,下回合開始額外 +1 靈息
N12.desc_en: End a turn with 3 or more Essence still in the pool and you gain +1 extra Essence at the start of the next turn

N14.desc_zh: 地圖上可預覽戰鬥節點的敵人組合
N14.desc_en: Preview the enemy line-up on battle nodes from the map

A01.desc_zh: 每回合可指定一位英雄使用他的兩顆骰子,該英雄不受「用一鎖一」限制
A01.desc_en: Each turn one hero of your choice may spend BOTH of their dice — they ignore the one-action-a-turn rule

A02.desc_zh: 全隊開戰時獲得荊棘 2,而且你的荊棘在回合結束時不會消退
A02.desc_en: The party starts every battle with Thorns 2, and your Thorns no longer decay at end of turn

A03.desc_zh: 你的吸血由 50% 提升至 100%,而且所有自損 -1(最低 0)
A03.desc_en: Your Lifesteal heals 100% instead of 50%, and every Pain cost is reduced by 1 (minimum 0)

A04.desc_zh: 重擲次數無限,但每次重擲全隊各受 1 點傷害(無視格擋)
A04.desc_en: Rerolls are unlimited, but each one deals 1 damage to every hero, ignoring Block

A05.desc_zh: 靈術消耗 -1(最低 1),而且每回合開始時 +1 靈息
A05.desc_en: Ritual costs are reduced by 1 (minimum 1), and you gain +1 Essence at the start of every turn

A06.desc_zh: 你每次攻擊之後,本回合隊伍的下一次攻擊 +1(回合內可疊加)
A06.desc_en: After each of your attacks, your party's next attack this turn gets +1 — it stacks within the turn
